method: Compared frozen Canon and ScriptIR with DirectorIR, six mapping rows and native hard clauses; independently reran native mapping and read-only V5 acceptance validation.

findings: 逐项复核冻结 Canon、ScriptIR 与六条编剧交接；沿用已通过独立语义审阅的 DirectorIR，确认8500/9000毫秒信完全在包内且不再作为可见主体。
本批修复原生 V5 RoleResult 的 screenplay review binding；六条映射使用同一当前复核标记，与 V6 两条 artifact handoff 分离。

semantic_finding: Rain night retained without specifying a location; one unopened letter remains throughout handoff, seal check and stow; no new dialogue; letter is inside backpack at 8500 and 9000 ms.
